name: feedback/toast-stack
title: Toast stack
description: Brief messages that stack, pause and dismiss.

files.content:
export { ToastProvider, useToast } from './ToastStack';
export type { ToastOptions, ToastProviderProps, ToastTone } from './ToastStack';

keyboard.action: Move focus to the newest notification.
Move through toasts’ buttons; the stack stays open and paused while focused.
Use the focused action or close button.

notes: Toasts are announced through a live region when they arrive: politely, and assertively for errors.
The stack is a labelled `region` landmark (“Notifications”) that F8 jumps to.
Timers pause while the pointer is over the stack or focus is inside it (WCAG 2.2.1), so nothing disappears while you read it.
Every close button names the toast it closes. Swiping is a shortcut, never the only way (WCAG 2.5.7).
Tone is shown with an icon and a coloured edge, not colour alone.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Toasts appear and rearrange without sliding or scaling.
